market_definition: The polyvinyl alcohol adhesives market comprises water-soluble adhesives based on partially or fully hydrolysed PVOH, valued for strong film formation and remoistenability. It measures sales of finished adhesives for paper, tube winding, bookbinding and remoistenable applications. BY HYDROLYSIS GRADE: Fully Hydrolysed, Partially Hydrolysed, Modified PVOH. BY FORM: Liquid Solution, Powder. BY END-USE INDUSTRY: Paper Tubes, Cores & Cartons, Bookbinding & Labels, Tissue & Hygiene, Textile Sizing & Finishing, Other End-Use Industries. BY REGION: North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia Pacific (APAC), Middle East, Africa. EXCLUDED from the market: PVAc and VAE emulsion adhesives; starch- or protein-based adhesives; PVOH film and resin sold for non-adhesive uses. COMPANY TYPE IN THIS LIST - DISTRIBUTOR: a distributor, stockist or specialty reseller that buys these products from their makers and sells them to industrial, construction or trade customers. EXCLUDED companies: product and raw-material makers and their own sales subsidiaries; companies selling only the excluded products; service-only firms.
who_is_included: DISTRIBUTOR DEFINITION (physical goods market): a company whose PRIMARY business is buying in volume from manufacturers and reselling/distributing onward - wholesale, authorized, value-added or stocking distributor. EXCLUDED: channel partners, resellers, VARs, dealers, agents and brokers that do not stock or wholesale; manufacturers and OEMs (including a manufacturer's own sales subsidiary); system integrators; and pure service providers or consultancies. Continent / Geography = countries with a physical site (HQ, office, warehouse, plant). Operational Presence = every country the company does business in, which is WIDER. Blank or NPD in a contact column means no published evidence was found - it is never a guess.
